name: WXETA
fix_description: In initialize, add s.initialized = true at the end of the function. The current code checks require(!s.initialized) but never sets it to true, allowing anyone to re-initialize the contract and take over ownership.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct exploit based on an obvious missing access control/unsafe initialization pattern: the attacker calls initialize(), mints an enormous amount to the pair, then drains value via a simple swap. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning and only a couple of external interactions, so a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly.
